identity.title: [tooling][csdlc-v2] Implemented-phase card recovery cannot repair review-blocking SPP/STP truth

values.summary: Add a narrow typed recovery operation or bounded authorization path, prove positive and negative behavior with focused tests, then validate and publish after exact review.

steps.action: Bootstrap, review, and bind #400 through typed C-SDLC v2.
Implement the narrow recovery operation/authorization path for SPP step and STP dependency truth repair.
Add focused positive and negative tests for #117-style recovery and guardrails.
Run focused validation, exact review, publication, and CI shepherding.

invariants: all lifecycle mutation routes remain typed
generation and digest CAS must match before mutation
publication still requires fresh exact-head review
risks: over-broad recovery could bypass review truth
SPP design-plan status semantics may conflict with execution truth if not explicitly bounded
dependency repair must not become a generic implemented-phase STP rewrite
stop_conditions: implementation requires broad lifecycle reset or raw card edits
focused validation or exact review fails
